rules: Default global agent rules: folders locked to the project, external calls ask, destructive commands ask. A teammate fixture adds the teammate's granted permissions.

expectations.ask: The Claude PreToolUse hook forwards the call to the desktop gate and the rules answer Ask: a person must approve it. The test plays the person and declines, so the hook returns deny.
expectations.deny: The hook forwards the call and the rules answer Deny without asking anyone.
expectations.folder-lock: The gate lets the command run, and the Landlock project lock makes it fail: the file outside the project cannot be read.
expectations.known-gap: Nothing refuses or escalates the call. Recorded so the gap is visible; the test fails if it closes, so the documentation gets updated.
